import subprocess
base='e3c1782b96'
old=base+'~10'
changed=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','-z',old,base,'--','*.ts','*.tsx','*.mts','*.cts']).decode().split('\0')
changed=[p for p in changed if p]
rows=[]
for path in changed:
    try:
        content=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'{base}:{path}'],stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).decode('utf-8')
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
        continue
    for n,line in enumerate(content.splitlines(),1):
        if '@plan' not in line: continue
        # A plan ID is the token immediately following @plan.
        import re
        m=re.search(r'@plan\s+([^\s*]+)',line)
        plan=m.group(1).rstrip('.,;:)'] if m else '(missing-id)'
        blame=subprocess.check_output(['git','blame','-s','-L',f'{n},{n}',base,'--',path],text=True).strip()
        commit=blame.split()[0][:7]
        package='packages/'+path.split('/')[1] if path.startswith('packages/') and len(path.split('/'))>1 else '(non-package)'
        rows.append((plan,package,commit,path,n,line.strip()))
from collections import Counter
print(f'Changed TypeScript files examined: {len(changed)}')
print(f'Marker occurrences: {len(rows)}')
print('\nBY PLAN ID')
for k,v in sorted(Counter(r[0] for r in rows).items()): print(f'{k}\t{v}')
print('\nBY PACKAGE')
for k,v in sorted(Counter(r[1] for r in rows).items()): print(f'{k}\t{v}')
print('\nBY BLAME SHORT HASH')
for k,v in sorted(Counter(r[2] for r in rows).items()): print(f'{k}\t{v}')
print('\nMARKERS')
for plan,pkg,commit,path,n,line in rows: print(f'{path}:{n}\t{plan}\t{pkg}\t{commit}\t{line}')
